note: Four reference locations: Copacabana Palace, Christ monument on Corcovado, Sugarloaf summit and Cosme Velho train station. Monument/summit coordinates are mapped OSM feature positions, not survey-grade exact coordinates. No altitude, streets, railway or cable car route lengths. QGIS numerical comparison is pending.

locations.name: Copacabana Palace — Main Entrance
locations.access_note: Approximate front entrance reference, Avenida Atlantica 1702. Entrance position still requires visual review.
locations.coordinate_basis: Provisional nearby reference based on published hotel location (-22.966944, -43.178611); not a verified entrance coordinate.

locations.name: Christ the Redeemer — Monument
locations.access_note: The Christ statue itself on Corcovado; distinct from the lower train station RIO04.
locations.coordinate_basis: OSM monument node 4919986733, version 33; latitude/longitude retrieved from the OSM API on 2026-10-24. Feature position, not a surveyed control point.

locations.name: Sugarloaf Mountain — Summit
locations.access_note: Pao de Acucar summit/peak feature; replaces the Praia Vermelha lower cable car station. Not the Morro da Urca summit.
locations.coordinate_basis: OSM natural=peak node 34582421, version 47; latitude/longitude retrieved from the OSM API on 2026-10-24. Mapped summit position, not a surveyed control point.

locations.name: Cosme Velho — Train Station Entrance
locations.access_note: Lower Corcovado train station access, Rua Cosme Velho 513. Retained as a separate point from the Christ monument.
locations.coordinate_basis: Rounded station reference: https://mapcarta.com/pt/W59988621 ; exact entrance pending review.
